name: What is the typical timeframe for a flooring installation project?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical timeframe for a flooring installation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a flooring installation project depends on several factors, including the type of flooring, the size of the area, and the amount of preparation needed. Smaller rooms with straightforward installations, like laminate, might be completed in 1-2 days. Larger projects involving hardwood, complex tile patterns, or extensive subfloor repair could take 3-7 days or more. We provide an estimated timeline during your initial consultation, ensuring clear communication throughout the process from material delivery to final walkthrough.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary by flooring type, area size, and prep work. Smaller jobs may take 1-2 days, while larger or more complex installations can take 3-7 days or longer.
